verdict.rationale: Fireworks documents structured outputs that force model responses to conform to a JSON schema. It also offers a Grammar mode using custom BNF grammars, which covers both halves of the story. The capability is documented only in first-party docs with brief excerpts. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of parse reliability, documentation of model coverage and limitations for schema/grammar enforcement.

support.subject: As a developer, I can enforce structured outputs against a JSON schema (or grammar) so model responses parse reliably

citations.quote: Force model output to conform to a JSON schema
Fireworks supports two methods: JSON mode (using JSON schemas) and Grammar mode (using custom BNF grammars).
Structured outputs ensure model responses conform to your specified format, making them easy to parse and integrate into your application.
